text: The wound is closed with black interrupted stitches (sutures), with tied ends visible along the line. There is reddish-brown bruising and streaking beyond the incision line, including a vertical streak on the right; no clear distance is visible. Swelling is not clearly visible. Reddish-brown crust and blood staining are present at several suture sites; no other discharge is visible. The wound edges appear together, not apart.
